\section{Introduction}

This is the introductory paragraph of a small test document. It contains enough running
text to make average per-page character counts meaningful for text-layer detection. The
quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, repeated a few times to pad out the body text so
that this page does not look like a comic page dominated by a single large image.

Inline math example: the identity $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ is one of the most celebrated results
in mathematics, and the quadratic formula $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}$ is another
one students see early on.

\section{A multi-line display formula}

Here is a display-mode equation spanning multiple visual lines, which should get merged
into a single formula bounding block by the region-detection logic:
\begin{align*}
  \int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx &= \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2} \\
  \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^2} &= \frac{\pi^2}{6} \\
  \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}
  \begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \end{pmatrix}
  &=
  \begin{pmatrix} ax+by \\ cx+dy \end{pmatrix}
\end{align*}
